name: Fiberon PETG-ESD @Creality Ender-3 Pro
filament_notes:
Fiberon manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 65 C for 3 h.
Manufacturer max speed 500 mm/s.
Fiberon FAQ states PETG-ESD is the only non-abrasive Fiberon material, although the product page boilerplate still says 'hardened nozzle due to abrasiveness' - hardened nozzle advisable but not strictly required. All-metal hotend 250 C+ recommended. Fan: TDS OFF, wiki max 50%. Speed: TDS up to 500 mm/s, wiki table 30-300 mm/s. Surface resistivity ~10^7 ohm at 250 C down to <10^4 at 290 C (higher nozzle temp = lower resistivity). Black; 0.5/1/3 kg spools.
Source: https://fiberon.polymaker.com/wp-content/uploads/TDS_FIBERON-PETG-ESD_V1.1_EN.pdf
